pushKeys.title: Push keys
pushKeys.description: The keys this server signs push notifications with.
pushKeys.regenerateBody: Use this if the keys may have leaked. Nothing is sent with the old keys again; each device gets push again once rooster has been opened on it.
pushKeys.confirmBody: New keys pause push on every device of every user. Each device renews its subscription the next time rooster is opened there; a device someone removed never comes back.
pushKeys.failed: Couldn’t regenerate the push keys. Try again.

reindex.body: Search reads a full-text index of every task, kept up to date as tasks change. Rebuild it if search misses tasks it should find.
reindex.confirmBody: Rebuilding reads every task and comment again. Search keeps working while it runs, and it usually takes a few seconds.
